description: Inspect a CSR (subject, SANs, key, signature check), OpenSSH public keys (type, bits, ssh-keygen fingerprints) or a JWK / JWKS (RFC 7638 thumbprint, PEM and OpenSSH forms). Private keys are refused. Operations: "inspect" — Inspect a PEM CSR or public key, OpenSSH public key lines (authorized_keys, known_hosts) or a JWK / JWK Set.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: A -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST----- or PUBLIC KEY block, one or more "ssh-ed25519 AAAA…" lines, or JWK JSON.

operation.description: inspect — Inspect a PEM CSR or public key, OpenSSH public key lines (authorized_keys, known_hosts) or a JWK / JWK Set.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: key-inspector
title: CSR, SSH Key & JWK Inspector
